title: Transitions and match cuts
what_it_does: Scene-to-scene transitions: the transitions-* block families (push, cover, blur, dissolve, grid, radial, ...), match-cut, text-match-cut, type-match-cut, whip-pan-cut, iris-reveal, curtain-reveal, fade-through, directional-wipe, plus GPU shader transitions.
why: Official. Shader transitions need GPU in the render browser; offer the DOM/clip-path ones by default.
